title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper Pro Input
description: Three ways in: paste LinkedIn jobs search URLs, type keywords, or paste company URLs to find every job at a target firm. Toggles control company enrichment, recruiter contact extraction, and city splitting.

searchUrls.title: LinkedIn jobs search URLs
searchUrls.description: LinkedIn jobs search URLs from your browser. Open LinkedIn jobs in incognito, set your filters, copy the URL. Each URL runs as its own search. Example: 'https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords=software%20engineer&location=United%20States&f_TPR=r604800'.

keywords.title: Keywords (alternative to URL input)
keywords.description: Job search terms. Each keyword runs as a separate search. Combined with locations below.

locations.title: Locations (used with keywords)
locations.description: Locations to combine with keywords. Use the spelling LinkedIn accepts. Leave empty for worldwide.

companyUrls.title: Company URLs (find every open job at a firm)
companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company URLs. The actor pulls every active job posting at each company. Example: 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/openai/'.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on jobs returned across all queries. Set to 0 for everything LinkedIn exposes (about 1000 per search).

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by seniority. Applied when keywords mode is used. Search URLs already carry their own filters.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.description: Employment type filter. Applied when keywords mode is used.

remoteFilter.title: Remote filter
remoteFilter.description: Restrict to onsite, remote, or hybrid roles.

postedSince.title: Posted since
postedSince.description: Only include jobs posted within this window.

splitByCity.title: Split search by city for high volume
splitByCity.description: When enabled, the actor splits each keyword search across the top cities of the chosen country. Use this to break past LinkedIn's roughly 1000 results per search cap.

country.title: Country to split by
country.description: Country whose top cities are used when splitByCity is on.

scrapeCompanyDetails.title: Scrape company details
scrapeCompanyDetails.description: Fetch each unique company's About page to enrich rows with industry, company size, headcount, founded year, headquarters, specialties, and active job count. Pushed as a separate dataset row per company.

scrapeRecruiterContact.title: Scrape recruiter contact
scrapeRecruiterContact.description: Parse the 'Meet the hiring team' block on each job detail to extract recruiter name, title, and LinkedIn profile URL. Pushed inline on the job row.

extractSkills.title: Extract skills
extractSkills.description: Scan the description for 250+ skills across tech, business, and soft skill categories. Returns a deduped sorted array on every job row.

parseSalary.title: Parse salary
parseSalary.description: Extract salary range, currency, and period from the description. Plausibility checks reject outliers like gift card amounts.

classifySeniority.title: Classify seniority tier
classifySeniority.description: Map the title to intern, entry, mid, senior, staff, lead, manager, director, vp, or c-suite.

detectEasyApply.title: Detect Easy Apply jobs
detectEasyApply.description: Flag jobs that use LinkedIn Easy Apply vs an external apply URL. Easy Apply jobs typically receive 3 to 5 times more applicants.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip job IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Four is the safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Datacenter works for low volume. Residential is required above a few hundred jobs or for company enrichment.
